008package paint.viewer.override.recording_exclude;
009
010/**
011 * Lightweight value object representing a single excluded recording.
012 * <p>
013 * Instances of this class correspond one-to-one with rows in {@code Viewer/Recording
014 * Exclude.csv}. The CSV contains a single column ("Recording Name") listing recordings that
015 * should be excluded from downstream processing. This class intentionally contains only the
016 * recording name. All exclusion semantics (how and where exclusions are applied) are handled
017 * elsewhere by importer and applier utilities.
018 * </p>
019 * <ul>
020 *   <li>Simple POJO with a single identifying field.</li>
021 *   <li>Used for CSV import/export and in-memory exclusion processing.</li>
022 *   <li>No business logic by design.</li>
023 * </ul>
024 */
025public class RecordingExclude {
026
027    /**
028     * Name of the recording to be excluded.
029     * Must exactly match the "Recording Name" used in Recordings.csv.
030     */
031    private String recordingName;
032
033    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
034    // CONSTRUCTORS
035    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
036
037    /**
038     * Default constructor required for CSV deserialization.
039     */
040    public RecordingExclude() {
041    }
042
043    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
044    // ACCESSORS
045    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
046
047    /**
048     * Returns the recording name associated with this exclusion.
049     *
050     * @return recording name
051     */
052    public String getRecordingName() {
053        return recordingName;
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * Sets the recording name associated with this exclusion.
058     *
059     * @param recordingName recording name to exclude
060     */
061    public void setRecordingName(String recordingName) {
062        this.recordingName = recordingName;
063    }
064
065    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
066    // DEBUG
067    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
068
069    @Override
070    public String toString() {
071        return "RecordingExclude{" +
072                "recordingName='" + recordingName + '\'' +
073                '}';
074    }
075}
